nodes.description: External pure function compute(uint256 x) that evaluates a large degree polynomial f(x) over the field defined by PRIME using Horner's method in inline assembly, then returns result % PRIME.
Input parameter x (uint256) supplied by the caller; used as the Horner multiplier in every mulmod step inside the assembly block.
Named return variable/local accumulator 'result' that is repeatedly updated by the chained add/mulmod Horner iterations and finally reduced modulo PRIME.
Local constant 0x800000000000011000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001 used as the modulus for every mulmod and for the final 'result % PRIME'.
Inline assembly block performing batched Horner iterations with add and mulmod against PRIME, plus the final 'result % PRIME' reduction; raw arithmetic with no explicit reason string or bounds check.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied parameter x flows into function compute as its only input.
The named return variable result carries the computed value back to the function's return.
Parameter x is consumed as the multiplier of every mulmod iteration in the assembly Horner evaluation.
PRIME is used as the modulus of every mulmod and of the final result % PRIME reduction inside the assembly block; arithmetic on this value determines overflow behaviour.
The assembly-computed value is assigned to result and returned as the function output.
Execution of compute unconditionally enters the inline assembly arithmetic block before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter x has no independent security role; it is an argument of compute and should be folded into the function node.
result is a transient local accumulator/return slot of compute and carries no separate state, so it merges into the function node.
PRIME is a local constant used solely as the modulus of the assembly add/mulmod operations, so it folds into that unsafe_operation node.
